description: This file defines a templated C++ class 'TlsEnabled' for managing TLS/SSL configuration in WebSocket connections, including certificate handling, context setup, and verification callbacks.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A templated class providing TLS/SSL setup and management for WebSocket connections, including certificate loading and verification.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate chain.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate files.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS setup by binding the TLS context creation callback.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if the TLS connection was successfully established and updates the result accordingly.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures a new SSL context for a TLS connection.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context from specified files or default paths.
